title: A duty log on the form drivers already know
description: Hours and events are entered on a familiar form, with a check before the export.

blocks.text: For some drivers a manual logbook may be more convenient than an automatic list of routes. In the example available, the user praises the log itself but does not explain which form he needs. This is a direction for a conversation about how records are kept today, not a confirmed request for a specific form.

quote.text: Hands down the best Log Book in market, thank you for returning such great app 5+

blocks.text: Take the form the person already uses and work one shift through with it. In the digital version, keep the order in which it is filled in, the ability to correct an entry, and the same document they can read.
If the log is used for mandatory record-keeping, compliance has to be checked separately for the particular country and purpose. The PDF on its own does not guarantee it.
